title: lora_recv_async 4.1.0 migration: lora_renode.c driver
description: Child 3 of 0l5j. Migrate lichen/drivers/lora/lora_renode.c recv_async (lora_renode.c:385, api at :433; self-rescheduling work-item poll design per its comments) to the Zephyr 4.x 3-arg contract (cb gains void *user_data; store and pass it on invocation). Use the shared compat macros from lichen/include/lichen/lora_compat.h (added in 0l5j.1). Verify in a renode/native_sim build that selects lora_renode.
